newsitem.title: UK: Girovend to list on London Stock Exchange.
newsitem.headline: Girovend to list on London Stock Exchange.

text.p: GiroVend Cashless Systems Plc, an assembler and supplier of cashless electronic payment systems, said on Monday it planned to float on the London Stock Exchange on March 6 via a placing.
The placing, at 160p, will raise a net 7.0 million stg and value the company at 20.8 million stg.
GiroVend said it provided cashless payment systems to closed user groups like factories, hospitals and schools.
The company said it recently entered into a cooperation agreement with Mondex, the "electronic purse" group, which has taken a ten percent stake in GiroVend.
The proceeds from the float will be used to cut borrowing and increase working capital, GiroVend said.
The broker and sponsor to the issue is Collins Stewart.
